reduced_rates.scope: medicines, medical devices and medical services by licensed providers (except exempt) — 2026 only

notes: CONFIRMED: Kazakhstan's new Tax Code (No. 214-VIII, signed 18 July 2025, in force 1 Jan 2026) raised VAT from 12% to 16%. Mandatory VAT registration threshold lowered to 10,000 MRP. VAT exemptions: medical care under ГОБМП/ОСМС, orphan/socially significant disease treatment, printed book publishing, archaeological works. Agricultural producers: additional VAT offset raised from 70% to 80%. The future_changes entry concerns the medical reduced rate (5%→10%), not the standard rate. Scheduled: from 2027-01-01: reduced-rate change only; standard rate stays 16%
